Tera Shell.scope: Requires encounter form/state transformation and reviewed replacement metadata.

Tera Shift.scope: Requires encounter form/state transformation and reviewed replacement metadata.

Teraform Zero.scope: Requires encounter form/state transformation and reviewed replacement metadata.

Teravolt.scope: Action-scoped foe type/damage/status immunity bypass, supported shields, decoys, redirection and charging-target access. Unique-effect stalemates, held items and unsupported effect blockers require GM adjudication.

Thermal Exchange.scope: Reviewed hit/Flinch triggers apply their named once-only attribute or defense changes. Fire/Water immunity and Burn protection apply where defined; boosts use a separate ability channel.

Thick Fat.scope: Reduce Fire and Ice move damage by one.

Tinted Lens.scope: Requires reviewed effect suppression, resistance, switch timing or counterpart attribute provenance.

Torrent.scope: Printed text grants 2 damage dice but icon grants 1. GM ruling required.

Tough Claws.scope: Add one damage die for the definition's Rock, Steel, Bite, Cutter, non-ranged Physical or Wind move condition; use catalog tags rather than inferred move prose.

Toxic Boost.scope: While the reviewed ailment is present, add two Special, Strength or Dexterity respectively. Quick Feet also ignores paralysis effects.

Toxic Chain.scope: A hostile non-ranged Physical hit rolls the reviewed two/three chance dice for Poison/Badly Poisoned, respecting source-aware immunity and Wonder Skin.

Toxic Debris.scope: Non-ranged Physical hits scatter persistent Toxic Spikes on the foe side. New eligible entrants roll one host Chance die for Badly Poisoned, otherwise Poison; Ground immunity and status protection apply.

Trace.scope: Host-rolled random eligible foe on entry; copied ability activates through shared hooks and ends on departure. Unique abilities cannot be copied.

Transistor.scope: Add two damage dice for the definition's Dragon or Electric type.

Triage.scope: Reviewed Basic Heal and status-cure Support moves gain Reaction 1, including selected allies and multi-target cures. Existing action, capacity, target, Will and phase validation apply. Unsupported healing/cure definitions remain manual.

Truant.scope: Requires repeated moves, restricted move selection or per-action choices/checks beyond the current action chain.

Turboblaze.scope: Action-scoped foe type/damage/status immunity bypass, supported shields, decoys, redirection and charging-target access. Unique-effect stalemates, held items and unsupported effect blockers require GM adjudication.

Unaware.scope: Requires reviewed effect suppression, resistance, switch timing or counterpart attribute provenance.

Unburden.scope: Requires held-item ownership, consumption, transfer or activation hooks.

Unnerve.scope: Requires held-item ownership, consumption, transfer or activation hooks.

Unseen Fist.scope: Non-ranged Physical Moves bypass Substitute/Shed Tail decoys. Remaining shield, force-field and Cover bypass hooks require implementation.

Vessel of Ruin.scope: Reduce the named defense/attribute by two in confirmed rank-limited range. Ruin holders and relevant stat protections are exempt; duplicate auras do not stack.

Victory Star.scope: Physical and Special moves of the user and living allies in confirmed range gain Never Miss.

Vital Spirit.scope: Immune to Sleep; unreviewed Rest/items remain manual.

Volt Absorb.scope: Immune to Electric damage; owner may restore one HP per hit, without an action or revival.

Wandering Spirit.scope: When the holder hits a foe with a non-ranged Physical move, exchange their effective ability identities. Does not trigger merely from receiving a hit. Unique abilities cannot be switched; contact assignments end on removal or scene end.

Water Absorb.scope: Immune to Water damage; owner may restore one HP per hit, without an action or revival.

Water Bubble.scope: Water moves gain two damage dice; reduce incoming Fire damage by one and ignore first/second Burn damage.

Water Compaction.scope: Reviewed hit/Flinch triggers apply their named once-only attribute or defense changes. Fire/Water immunity and Burn protection apply where defined; boosts use a separate ability channel.

Weak Armor.scope: Reviewed hit/Flinch triggers apply their named once-only attribute or defense changes. Fire/Water immunity and Burn protection apply where defined; boosts use a separate ability channel.

Well-Baked Body.scope: Reviewed hit/Flinch triggers apply their named once-only attribute or defense changes. Fire/Water immunity and Burn protection apply where defined; boosts use a separate ability channel.

White Smoke.scope: Protect the reviewed stat changes through sourced battle effects and supported moves; Clear Body also rejects external increases and Flower Veil protects in-range allies.

Wimp Out.scope: Crossing to half HP or less queues a controlled owner/GM reserve choice, ignoring Block. Switcher icon uses inherited initiative and remaining actions. One completed switcher effect per affected trainer per round; no reserve needs an explicit GM outcome.

Wind Power.scope: A qualifying damaging hit charges the next Electric attack for two extra damage dice. Shared damage snapshots preserve the charge across targets.

Wind Rider.scope: Add one damage die for the definition's Rock, Steel, Bite, Cutter, non-ranged Physical or Wind move condition; use catalog tags rather than inferred move prose.

Wonder Guard.scope: Prevent non-super-effective move damage and supported indirect damage; condition damage still applies.

Wonder Skin.scope: Reduce chance dice for supported incoming added effects by two; independent selectors remain independent.

Zen Mode.scope: Requires encounter form/state transformation and reviewed replacement metadata.

Zero to Hero.scope: Requires encounter form/state transformation and reviewed replacement metadata.
